rules: Phase 1 implementation cannot start without an M0 PASS gate bound to an immutable commit.
Every required P1-V00 through P1-V10 step must PASS before IMPLEMENTED is valid.
FAIL, BLOCKED, UNAVAILABLE, INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_RUN on a required step blocks IMPLEMENTED.
All P1-O01 through P1-O09 suboperations must be IMPLEMENTED.
Every qualification obligation from ADR-0007 through ADR-0011 must PASS with Evidence.
WRITE_SCOPE is deny-by-default; immutable authority files cannot be modified by an implementation operation.
No alternate driver, transport, evaluator or isolation downgrade is permitted without a superseding ADR.
Implementation agents may not declare VERIFIED.
